# Kex documentation

Everything published at https://docs.kex.run: the Guide, written by hand, then the
reference generated from each package's source, one section per version.

How to read this with an LLM: start with the Guide, then the reference
section marked (current). Versions ending in `-dev` are unreleased
snapshots. Every page also exists as raw Markdown, linked beside it, and
the whole corpus concatenated is `llms-full.txt`. Each reference version
carries its own `model.json` (the full typed model) and `search.json`.

## Guide

- [Kex documentation](https://docs.kex.run/) ([Markdown](https://docs.kex.run/index.md))
- [Guide](https://docs.kex.run/guide/0.4.0-alpha/) ([Markdown](https://docs.kex.run/guide/0.4.0-alpha.md))
- [Overview](https://docs.kex.run/guide/0.4.0-alpha/overview/) ([Markdown](https://docs.kex.run/guide/0.4.0-alpha/overview.md))
- [Syntax](https://docs.kex.run/guide/0.4.0-alpha/syntax/) ([Markdown](https://docs.kex.run/guide/0.4.0-alpha/syntax.md))
